subject: Mike
text: In the large desert east of the cave, talk to the man and rent his camel to get the pizza.

evidence.quote:
When you come out of the cave, you'll be in a large desert.  Head east and you 
will spot a man, a camel, and a oasis.  Talk to the man and rent his camel so 
you can get the pizza.

subject: Cleopatra
text: After the queen finishes the pizza, her barge sets sail across the river, she reveals a pyramid to the south contains the Tetrad, and trades your stone age axe for a bronze dagger.

evidence.quote:
After the queen is finished eating the entire pizza (man, I can't even do 
that!) she has the barge set sail and cross the river.  Cleopatra tells you 
there is a pyramid to the south, and inside you will find the Tetrad.  She'll 
also trade your stone age axe for a bronze dagger.

subject: Pyramid
text: In the first room of the pyramid, step on the center title in the western group to get some hearts.

evidence.quote: Head south, following the desert path, and you'll come to the pyramid.  Step on the center title in the western group in the first room to get some hearts.

subject: Energy barrier
text: The next room inside the pyramid has an energy barrier with no way through, prompting you to go back outside and talk to two men.

evidence.quote:
In the next room, though, 
you find a energy barrier with no way to get through it.  So head back outside 
again and talk to the two men who are now there.

subject: Grass Field
text: A heart container is located in the eastern part of the Grass Field maze.

evidence.quote:
Don't miss the heart 
container that is the eastern part of the maze.

subject: Magician
text: Exiting the maze to the north leads outside to the man, who grants you the psychic shock wave to attack enemies and destroy barriers before warping you back to the pyramid.

evidence.quote:
Finally you exit the maze 
to the north and go outside again, where the man comes down to talk to you.  He 
gives you the ability of the psychic shock wave, a mental attack that can be 
used on enemies and grows stronger as you do.  He says it can also be used to 
destroy barriers.  Then he warps you back to the pyramid.

subject: Pyramid
text: In the room with a circle of titles, stepping in the center causes a pitfall; hold left or right on the pad while falling to land safely in the next room.

evidence.quote:
In another room with a 
circle of titles you need to step in the center, and you will fall down a pit.  
Hold left or right on the pad as you fall and you will land allright in the next 
room, otherwise, you fall into another room.

subject: Flute
text: Inside the pyramid, pick up the magical flute and blow it in subsequent rooms; in one room, three snakes emerge from the west wall, which open the correct passage when defeated.

evidence.quote:
You also pick up a magical item, the flute.  Blow it in all 
the rooms you come to after you get it and in one three snakes will come out of 
the west wall.  Defeat them to open the correct passage to proceed.

subject: Medicine
text: There are a total of three medicines to be found inside the pyramid.

evidence.quote:
There is a 
total of three medicines to be found so be careful.

subject: Monster Mask
text: Against Monster Mask, stay close to the wall moving against arrows, hit him constantly with daggers from one side to the other, and avoid getting in front of his fatal mouth energy blast.

evidence.quote:
When he's close to you, however, he stops, his eyes open wide, and he fired a 
powerful energy blast from his mouth.  You can only take one hit from this 
before you die, so be careful NOT to get hit with it!...Just stay 
close to the wall, moving against the arrows, and hit him constantly with your 
daggers from one side to the other.  Never get in the center of him or risk 
facing a attack from his mouth.

subject: Tetrad
text: Defeating Monster Mask allows you to leave the pyramid and enter a small room containing the Tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Keep up 
the heat and soon he'll be dead and you can head out of the pyramid.  Then 
you'll be in a small room in which you find the Tetrad.

subject: Jail Cell
text: If thrown in jail by the police officer, press against a section of the eastern wall of your cell to escape.

evidence.quote:
If you talk to 
the police officer, he throws you in jail.  Press against a section of the 
eastern wall of your cell to get out.

subject: Manhole
text: Outside after the museum encounter, head down the manholes to your left first to find a heart container.

evidence.quote:
When you find yourself outside again, head down the manholes to your left first 
to find a heart container.

subject: Sewer
text: There is one medicine that can be found down in the first sewer area.

evidence.quote:
There is one medicine that 
can be found down here in the sewers.

subject: Zoda's Creature
text: To fight Zoda's Creature, go to the top-right platform, jump between the appearing rafts throwing daggers, and return to dry land to repeat.

evidence.quote:
You need to go up to the top-right platform and jump for the first raft.  Then 
you need to jump around on the rafts that pop up, one after another, until after 
the last one you jump back to dry land, go back to the platform, and repeat.  
You only have time on each raft to throw a couple daggers before you need to 
move.

subject: Sewer, Part II
text: In Sewer, Part II, there are four medicines to be found across hidden rooms and title pit drops, along with throwing stars in two locations.

evidence.quote:
Not very far in you'll find a secret room 
where you can get some medicine....You will 
find yet another medicine for a total of four in this stage, plus some throwing 
stars in two locations.

subject: Sewer, Part II
text: In the room with three groups of titles, fall down the center of the left group first, then the right one, and finally the center group to reach the level below.

evidence.quote:
There are three 
groups of titles here -- walking into the center of one of the groups causes you 
to fall down to the level below.  Fall down the left one first, then the right 
one, and finally the center.

subject: Zoda
text: Against Zoda, jump over or dodge his bullet spread at close range, or carefully avoid/stay in the center of the three or four blue fires he fires when far away.

evidence.quote:
Depending on how far away you are from him determines 
his attack -- if you're close, it's a spread of bullets that must be jumped over 
or dodged.  If you're far away, he fires three or four blue fires that spring up 
in the area around Mike, and you either have to stay in the center till it fades 
or very carefully get out of them.

subject: Sewer, Part II
text: After defeating Zoda, head north into the sewers to pick up the dropped Tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Head north to exit.

Back in the sewers again you'll find the stolen Tetrad that Zoda had dropped 
after his defeat.

subject: Store
text: In the Old West town, talk to the store owner to receive dynamite for blasting through rock walls.

evidence.quote:
Go to the store and talk to the 
owner, and he gives you some dynamite.

subject: Mountain side
text: Bomb the spot between two small boulders in the southern part of the mountain wall to find a heart container.

evidence.quote:
Down in the southern part of the mountain wall 
there are two small boulders.  Bomb the spot in between them and you'll find a 
heart container.

subject: Mountain side
text: Gold nuggets can be found by blasting the cave where the colored rock trail ends, bombing two spaces north of the northern colored cave, and bombing the southernmost part of the wall.

evidence.quote:
Walk up to the rock 
wall where that trail of colored rocks ends and Mike will set the dynamite, 
allowing you to enter the cave.  Inside all you find is a gold nugget, though, 
no Tetrad!...Two spaces north of the northern colored cave you find another 
gold nugget.  Yet another gold nugget can be found if you bomb the southern most 
part of the wall that you can.

subject: Gold Cave
text: Bombing the spot three spaces south of the southern colored rock cave opens the path to the gold cave.

evidence.quote:
I DO know the correct cave can be found 
if you bomb the spot three spaces south of the southern colored rock cave.  After 
a short walk you're in the gold 
cave.

subject: Gold Cave
text: Inside the Gold Cave, you pick up bolas, a medicine along a hidden path, and must shoot the north wall in the second room to proceed.

evidence.quote:
You also need to fire on the north wall here to proceed -- the first 
time that's required....Remember what I said earlier about checking out rooms with hidden paths first?  
You'll find a medicine this way....You also pick up some bolas that will come in handy later.
